sectionsUsed: Java SE 25 API, Throwable.printStackTrace: the first line contains the result of toString(); the remaining lines list the recorded frames; "Caused by:" sections follow for causes; lines with "..." indicate that the remainder of the stack trace matches frames of the enclosing trace.
Java SE 25 API, StackTraceElement: each frame records the class, method, file name and line number; toString shows the module prefix such as java.base/ for JDK frames.
Java SE 25 API, NullPointerException.getMessage: returns the detail message, or a computed message that describes the null value.

JEP 358, Helpful NullPointerExceptions: the message names the failed action and the null value, such as "the return value of <method>", a field shown with its owner, and local variables by name only when a local variable table is available (compiled with -g), otherwise as a placeholder.
